newsitem.title: USA: Noel Group sets liquidation vote March 19.
newsitem.headline: Noel Group sets liquidation vote March 19.

text.p: Noel Group Inc said Tuesday it had scheduled a shareholder meeting for March 19 to approve a plan to liquidate and dissolve the company.
The plan was previously approved by the board, subject to shareholder approval.
The shareholder meeting will be held at 1000 EST at the Mayfair Hotel here, the company said.

The company said the liquidation is expected to begin as soon as practicable after shareholder approval and would be concluded within three years by a final liquidation distribution either directly to shareholders or to one or more liquidation trusts.
